key_finding: Adding the conformal width trigger reduces total IFRS9 misclassification cost by 0.0% vs pure PD threshold. The asymmetric cost function (w_fn=5.0, w_fp=1.0) reflects that under-provisioning (FN) is regulatorily costlier than over-provisioning (FP). The combined trigger reduces FN errors by capturing high-uncertainty loans that the PD threshold alone misses.
